precision: float64 for beta values, means, variances, transformations and spectral calculations

definitions.aggregation_A: At each probe, h of the equally weighted mean beta across six donors; reported as the probe sum and median.
definitions.aggregation_B: At each probe, the equally weighted mean of six donor-specific h(beta) values; reported as the probe sum and donor summaries.
definitions.donor_summary: Arithmetic mean of h(beta) over 481737 probes for each identified donor/sample. Between-donor SD uses ddof=1.
definitions.R: Sample variance of cell-type means divided by that variance plus the mean of within-cell-type sample variances. Both variance operations use ddof=1; zero denominator gives R=0.
definitions.ranking: Descending discovery R6 among the 448510 common probes; probe identifier ascending resolves exact ties. External beta values and labels are not used.
definitions.spectral_matrix: Selected probe rows are centered and divided by sample SD across the same 36 discovery samples. Nonzero probe-correlation eigenvalues are obtained from Z.T @ Z / 35.
definitions.constant_probes: Rows with exactly identical beta values across all 36 discovery samples are excluded from correlation standardization. Marginal-profile sums retain all selected probes.
definitions.participation_ratio: 1 / sum(q_k squared), q_k = retained lambda_k / sum(retained lambda)
definitions.marginal_sum: Equally weighted mean of six population-specific sums of h(donor-mean beta) over the selected probes; units bits. Spectral dimensions are dimensionless.
definitions.quantiles: NumPy linear interpolation quantiles across the eligible probes.
